notes.title: Developer Update / SUFFER 2 v1.1.3 Patch
notes.content:
SUFFER 2 v1.1.3 Patch Notes

This is just a performance patch that focusses on 4 "problem" levels. 

This will be the last patch for awhile, special thanks to my friend Roman whose feedback was invaluable. You really helped make SUFFER 2 the best it could possibly be.

I'm taking a break from game development for awhile. Thank you to everyone for playing my games. This has been a fun and rewarding journey but I am very tired now. I hope everyone has a lot of fun with this game - if you enjoy it please consider recommending it on Steam. Maybe one day I will return to implement additional content if I see that people like SUFFER... But for now I need to rest.

Thank you for everything,
Shawn

notes.title: SUFFER 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

I'm extremely proud to announce that SUFFER 2 is officially live on Steam!

[previewyoutube=9idhm09gHvk;full][/previewyoutube]

This game has been in development for over two years and I believe it is a huge improvement over the original! The music, graphics, and sound have all been vastly improved and I've learned so much about level design since the original that these new stages are my best yet. The game works great on Valve's Steam Deck and plays perfectly even on older hardware.

If you haven't played the original you won't feel lost if you start with SUFFER 2 - this is a boomer shooter first and the story is very light. The Leviathan Government has taken control and destroyed the world! It's up to The Spirit of Anarchy to end their tyranny with ninja swords and extreme firepower! With 5 difficulty settings and 39 levels there is plenty of content here to keep you coming back for more SUFFER!

Thank you to everyone for the support over the years. This game is my best yet and I hope you all enjoy it. I have some future updates planned but right now I'm focused on getting this one out there to the players. It's way more polished than the original and I am incredibly happy with how it turned out.

Seriously, thank you :)

notes.title: SUFFER 2 Release Date
notes.content:
Hey Friends!

I am very pleased to announce that SUFFER 2 will be released this coming January, on Friday the 13th! I've been working really hard on this one, I can't wait for everyone to be able to play it. In the mean time, I made another teaser trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9idhm09gHvk

SUFFER 2 is a lot more polished than the original and I truly think it is a much better game. I've learned a lot since creating the first game and it shows!

Thank you for the support, it really means a lot. I make these games all by myself so it's overwhelming to see people enjoy them. 

Thank you

notes.title: SUFFER 2 and the Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hope you are doing well! 

It's not much of an update, but SUFFER 2 is nearly ready for launch so I figured I'd drop a video showing it in action... on Valve's Steam Deck! 

[previewyoutube=qPiljEg5FhQ;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been using the Steam Deck to benchmark the game and it is the target hardware. The game is a joy to play with the Deck's controller and awesome screen and the game runs at a smooth 60fps (most of the time!)

I'm readying my final build of SUFFER 2 now - once I know for sure if I can launch the game I will post an update with the release date. Stay tuned!
